name: sales-partial-delivery-en
query: Deliver 5 x {partial_order_item} from sales order {partial_order_docnum} now; the rest of the order ships later.
expected_behavior: Looks the order up by the DocNum the user quoted
The proposed delivery is copied from the order — the receipt references the base order and its line rather than presenting hand-typed lines
The delivery contains only the requested item, with quantity 5, and none of the order's other lines
Says or implies the order stays open for the remaining quantities
Shows a confirmation receipt and stops to ask the user to confirm before posting
